const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboCasa365 RetrieveMeat controller.
+
+This file is the controller record for the single live episode.  It uses only
+the service's robot proprioception and calibrated RGB-D camera observations.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+CAM_HAND = 'robot0_eye_in_hand'
+CAM_CENTER = 'robot0_agentview_center'
+
+
+def state_from_meta(meta):
+    p = meta['proprio']
+    return dict(zip(p['layout'], p['now']))
+
+
+def arm_q(state):
+    return np.array([state[f'robot0_joint{i}_pos'] for i in range(1, 8)], dtype=float)
+
+
+def xyz(state):
+    return np.array([state['eef_right_x'], state['eef_right_y'], state['eef_right_z']], dtype=float)
+
+
+def command(robot, q=None, grip=-1.0, base=(0., 0., 0.), torso=0.0, n=1,
+            mode=-1.0, note=''):
+    """Submit n native control steps with one held composite-controller action."""
+    if q is None:
+        q = arm_q(state_from_meta(robot.get_obs(cameras=[CAM_HAND], video='none').meta))
+    a = np.zeros((int(n), 13), dtype=np.float64)
+    a[:, :7] = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
+    a[:, 7] = grip
+    a[:, 8:11] = np.asarray(base, dtype=float)
+    a[:, 11] = torso
+    a[:, 12] = mode
+    return robot.submit('joint_position', a, interpolate='hold', cameras=[CAM_HAND],
+                        video='none', note=note)
+
+
+def world_point_from_depth(meta, depth, uv):
+    """Project one RGB-D pixel using the response's CV intrinsics and GL pose."""
+    cam = meta['cameras'][CAM_HAND]
+    K = np.asarray(cam['intrinsic_cv'], dtype=float)
+    T = np.asarray(cam['cam2world_gl'], dtype=float)
+    u, v = map(float, uv)
+    d = float(depth[int(round(v)), int(round(u))])
+    pix_cv = np.array([(u-K[0, 2])*d/K[0, 0], (K[1, 2]-v)*d/K[1, 1], -d, 1.])
+    return (T @ pix_cv)[:3]
+
+
+def save_observation(obs, name):
+    d = OUT / name
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (d / 'meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+    for cam, im in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(im).save(d / f'{cam}.png')
+    for cam, dep in obs.depth.items():
+        np.save(d / f'{cam}_depth.npy', dep)
+
+
+def main():
+    robot = Robot()
+    print(json.dumps(robot.spec(), indent=2))
+    print(json.dumps(robot.status(), indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));

+    im = obs.last[CAM_HAND].astype(float)

+    yy, xx = np.indices(dep.shape)
+    red = (im[:, :, 0] > 55) & (im[:, :, 0] > 1.25*im[:, :, 1])
+    roi = (xx >= 195) & (xx <= 251) & (yy >= 30) & (yy <= 75)
+    m = red & roi & (dep > 0.05) & (dep < 1.0)
+    uv = np.column_stack((xx[m], yy[m]))
+    if len(uv) < 20:
+        raise RuntimeError(f'fish not found in hand-camera ROI ({len(uv)} red pixels)')
+    pts = np.array([world_point_from_depth(obs.meta, dep, p) for p in uv])
+    # Ignore shelf-edge outliers by taking the middle 80% around each coordinate.
+    med = np.median(pts, axis=0)
+    keep = np.all(np.abs(pts-med) <= np.array([.07, .07, .06]), axis=1)
+    return np.median(pts[keep], axis=0), int(keep.sum())

+def pose_step(q, p, R, p_goal, R_goal, Jp, Jr, max_joint_step=.14, damping=.02):
+    """One damped local 6-D IK update using the measured camera/EE Jacobian."""
+    dp = np.asarray(p_goal, dtype=float) - np.asarray(p, dtype=float)
+    dw = Rotation.from_matrix(R_goal @ R.T).as_rotvec()
+    J = np.vstack((Jp, Jr))
+    err = np.r_[dp, dw]
+    # Keep the gripper orientation while giving translation and rotation comparable scales.
+    W = np.diag([1., 1., 1., .4, .4, .4])
+    JW = W @ J
+    rhs = W @ err
+    dq = JW.T @ np.linalg.solve(JW @ JW.T + damping*damping*np.eye(6), rhs)
+    peak = float(np.max(np.abs(dq)))
+    if peak > max_joint_step:
+        dq *= max_joint_step/peak

+    dq = np.asarray(dq, dtype=float)

+def position_step(q, p, R, p_goal, R_goal, Jp, Jr, max_joint_step=.12,
+                  angular_weight=.1, damping=.05):
+    """Position-first visual-servo step with a soft penalty on wrist rotation."""
+    dp = np.asarray(p_goal, dtype=float) - np.asarray(p, dtype=float)
+    dp_norm = float(np.linalg.norm(dp))
+    if dp_norm > .04:
+        dp *= .04/dp_norm
+    dw_now = Rotation.from_matrix(R_goal @ R.T).as_rotvec()
+    # Correct at most 0.02 rad of accumulated wrist error per command chunk.
+    dw_goal = dw_now * min(1., .02/max(float(np.linalg.norm(dw_now)), 1e-12))

+    peak = float(np.max(np.abs(dq)))
